originalTitle: GODZILLA MINUS ZERO | Official Trailer 3 - NOW PLAYING
content: GODZILLA MINUS ZERO #FilmedForIMAX VFX, Written, and Directed by Takashi Yamazaki Now Playing in theatres nationwide & IMAX Follow @godzilla_toho and @GKIDSfilms for more updates! godzillaminuszero.com War reduced Japan to zero, and Godzilla plunged it into minus. Two years have passed since then, and the country has faced agonizing struggles to achieve recovery and finally reclaim its daily life. Just as humanity managed to cling to a hard-won peace, a new threat strikes, crushing hope in an instant. There is no third time. Everything ends here. Shot entirely in Japan as the first-ever Japanese production to be Filmed For IMAX, GODZILLA MINUS ZERO was shot with high-definition digital cameras certified by IMAX, and optimized in sound and imagery unique to IMAX screens. The globally beloved monster returns to movie theater screens reaching greater and more terrifying heights, making GODZILLA MINUS ZERO a true cinematic event not to be missed.
chineseSummary: TOHO 的《哥斯拉官方》· 1,096,077 次观看
chineseContent: 《哥斯拉负零》#FilmedForIMAX 视觉特效，由山崎贵编剧和导演，现已在全国影院和 IMAX 上映，关注 @godzilla_toho 和 @GKIDSfilms 了解更多更新！ godzillaminuszero.com 战争将日本降至零，而哥斯拉则将其降至负值。两年过去了，这个国家经历了艰苦的斗争，才得以恢复并最终恢复正常生活。正当人类努力维持来之不易的和平时，新的威胁袭来，希望瞬间破灭。没有第三次了。一切到这里就结束了。 《哥斯拉减零》完全在日本拍摄，是首部在 IMAX 上拍摄的日本作品，采用经过 IMAX 认证的高清数码摄像机拍摄，并针对 IMAX 屏幕特有的声音和图像进行了优化。全球深受喜爱的怪兽重返电影院银幕，达到了更高、更恐怖的高度，使《零之哥斯拉》成为一场不容错过的真正电影盛事。
